edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller full privileged control.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the source account key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] based on the caller identity.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance with an underflow check.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance with an overflow check.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom decreases the allowed nested mapping entry.
approve overwrites the allowed[owner][spender] entry with the requested amount.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled address after state is written.
The allowance state is updated before the external call, enabling reentrant use of the fresh allowance.
The spender parameter fully determines the address of the external callback target.
Attacker-supplied bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied token contract.
tokenAddress determines which external contract is invoked for the sweep.
The stored owner address is passed as the recipient of the swept tokens.
The constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed 12,000,000 token amount.
The constructor assigns the entire supply to the fixed deployment address in balances.
totalSupply reads the stored _totalSupply value.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction on _totalSupply without SafeMath.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction operation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested account.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping for owner and spender.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into the pending newOwner slot.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after confirmation.
The _newOwner parameter flows directly into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is used as the key for the balances lookup.
The 'to' parameter is used as the recipient key in the balances mapping.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed into safeSub and safeAdd.
spender is the second key written into the allowed mapping.
tokens is stored as the approved allowance value.
from is the debited account key in both balances and allowed.
to is the credited account key in the balances mapping.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the first key of the allowed lookup.
spender is the second key of the allowed lookup.
spender is written to allowed and used as the external call target.
tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded to the callback.
data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval invocation.
tokenAddress selects the ERC20 contract cast and invoked.
tokens is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.

Spender parameter is only a key for the allowed mapping write in approve.
Allowance amount stored by approve; no independent semantics.
Source account key used exclusively inside transferFrom.
Destination account key used exclusively inside transferFrom.
Transfer amount consumed by the SafeMath calls in transferFrom.
First lookup key of the read-only allowance view.
Second lookup key of the read-only allowance view.
Spender parameter determines both the allowance key and the external callback target.
Allowance amount set and forwarded by approveAndCall.
Opaque calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter is cast to ERC20Interface and called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount argument passed into the external ERC20 transfer call.
